newsitem.title: USA: Amex march short interest rises 12.4 million.
newsitem.headline: Amex march short interest rises 12.4 million.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said Thursday that short interest reached a record 148,245,083 shares on March 14, an increase of 12,400,271 from the previous month's record of 135,844,812 shares.
The exchange reports short interest, an indicator of the number of investors who expect stock prices to fall, on a monthly basis.
